The fix is in 4.6.6; zod 3 has none, and steiger (0.8.0 too) pins ^3.25.76. Steiger is the FSD lint CLI and validates only our own config with it; nothing of it ships. Every zod 4 copy is at >=4.6.6 through the package.json overrides.
